title: astragalus subacaulis
intro: Astragalus subacaulis, commonly known as Chinese milkvetch, is a plant species belonging to the legume family Fabaceae. This herb is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to support immune function and overall health. Astragalus subacaulis is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which may help to prevent illness and improve recovery from disease. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus subacaulis include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and polysaccharides, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions.
